title: Bellinge combined sewer system (Odense, Denmark) — field validation
description: 1.7 km² mainly combined urban drainage system with up to 10 years of level, flow and pump-power observations and a published EPA SWMM model. A candidate is run on the published network with observed rainfall and judged against measured water levels at the 13 level meters.

citations.title: The Bellinge data set: open data and models for community-wide urban drainage systems research
Dataset for Bellinge: An urban drainage case study

provenance.adaptation_notes: Uses only CC BY 4.0 items: 7 – Models (SWMM), 2 – Sensor data, 3b – radar and meteorological-station rainfall. Item 3a (rain gauges) is CC BY-NC 4.0 and is deliberately excluded so the case stays usable by commercial vendors. The published SWMM model is uncalibrated (ESSD paper §4); event selection and the validation window are still to be fixed.
